item.content:
About me

Recently graduated from the HEIG-VD with a Bachelor in Software Engineering.

I am driven by curiosity and have a deep passion for the myriad facets of video game developement. Be it the technical challenges or the UX ones.

My Bachelor’s thesis focused on state of the art performance for 3D real time applications, namely, video games. The work was written in French and has earned the highest possible grading (6/6). It can be found publicly On my GitHub.

Aside from computers I have an interest for Japan. Not only about its modern pop culture impact, but also its tradition, history, and martial arts. I’ve obtained a black belt in the Bodaïshinkan Ryu school, for japanese weapons.

I also hike in the beautiful Switzerland mountains, when time and mood strikes.

Knowledge

Spoken Languages

Despite not completing any English certificate past the B2 level, I use, and understand it, in a much more proefficient manner than German, which stands at the same certificate level.

> grep languages /etc/spoken
English French (German)

Programming Languages

While I’ve dabbled in many languages, low to high level, my preference goes to the higher ones, and strongly typed at that. Those two characteristics smoothens the process of adding programming structures. If the language offers a functional paradigm, it makes it all the better.

> grep languages /etc/code
C C++ C# Java Kotlin
Go Python Rust Scala Haskell
JS PHP HTML/CSS

Tools

This list is but a glance at the many tools I’ve had the occasion to work for. Some only for smaller projects, some for far more complex ones, like Unity, during my time at MindMaze.

> grep tools /etc/code
[Version Control]
Git GitHub GitLab Bitbucket
[Containers]
Docker
[Frameworks]
Quarkus Bootstrap React
[DBMS]
Couchbase ElasticSearch Neo4J PostgreSQL
[Infra / Cloud]
Kubernetes AWS Google Cloud
[Game Dev]
Unity Godot Blender
